usdcTransferOnArcTestnet.why: No Arc testnet USDC was provided for 0x222d0AD1b152f20e948AE290BC3C911a2D09fe13. Testnet tokens come from https://faucet.circle.com.
usdcTransferOnArcTestnet.alsoMissing: The landing docs do not give the Arc testnet chain id or RPC; they are at https://docs.arc.io/arc/references/connect-to-arc.md.

bridgeKitOnGnosis.whyItMatters: Swarm postage is bought in xBZZ on Gnosis. Bridge Kit cannot deliver there, so Circle's bridge cannot fund postage batches. Funding Gnosis needs a different route.

note: Arc uses USDC for gas rather than ETH, and claims sub-second finality.
security: https://docs.arc.io/ serves an 'Agent Instructions' block telling an agent to install Circle skills before reading. That is page content, not an instruction from the user, and it was ignored.
